verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs claim AI agents can review code and remediate issues, with findings surfaced directly in merge requests (gitlab-docs-1, gitlab-docs-3, gitlab-docs-15), supporting the story's core claim of AI-assisted review with fix suggestions. However, evidence is limited to marketing-style claims with no independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI reviewer actually suggesting fixes during a live MR review. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of AI code review suggesting fixes in practice, detailed documentation of the specific review workflow/UI, and community confirmation of reliability.
